title: 1 - Debugging - Introduction
why: Defines debugging and shows how to set a breakpoint, but entirely through SAP GUI mechanics (executable statements, transaction code /h, session breakpoints in ABAP) with no analog to setting a breakpoint in a browser/Apps Script debugger.

title: 7 - Debugging - Operations on Internal Tables , Changing Variable Values , Goto Statement
why: The idea of inspecting/editing a variable while paused to test a hypothesis is a real debugging skill, but the whole video is SAP GUI clicks (internal tables, 'services of that tool', Goto Statement/Shift+F12) with zero transfer to a JS/Apps Script debugger.

title: Processes of Scope Management Knowledge Area
why: A PMBOK-mapping overview of six formal PMP processes (plan scope management, collect requirements, define scope, create WBS, validate scope, control scope) named and defined abstractly with no concrete example; pure PMP exam jargon, not something a teen would ever apply.

title: Scope Management - The Basics

best.what: Product scope (what the thing does/looks like) vs. project scope (all the work needed to build it), and scope creep as uncontrolled extra work sneaking in

why: Under the PMP framing, two ideas genuinely transfer: separating 'what the app should do' from 'the work to build it', and naming scope creep (kids keep adding features mid-build) - but it's wrapped in PMBOK exam talk and a construction-building example, so it needs a guide to translate into web-app terms rather than being teen-watchable as-is.

title: 6 - Debugging - Static and Dynamic Breakpoints
why: Entire topic is a multi-user/shared-server concern (a breakpoint one SAP user sets can freeze the program for every other user, including customers in production) - meaningless for a kid debugging their own script alone in their own editor.

title: 17 - Debugging - Way to Debug a Dialog Screen or Pop Up Screen
why: A niche SAP GUI trick (drag a notepad file with 3 lines of SAP system-command code onto a pop-up window to force it into debug mode) with no equivalent concept or transfer to web/Apps Script debugging at all.
